career_ladder.note: Officers recruited through the Himachal Pradesh Administrative Service (HPAS) Combined Competitive Examination are governed by the Himachal Pradesh Administrative Service Rules and the Himachal Pradesh Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2022. Officers enter as Sub-Divisional Magistrates (SDMs) / Assistant Commissioners and advance through state administrative grades before induction into the Indian Administrative Service (IAS — Himachal Pradesh Cadre).

exam_scheme.note: The Himachal Pradesh Administrative Service (HPAS) Combined Competitive Examination is conducted in three successive stages: Preliminary Examination (Objective screening test), Main Examination (Conventional descriptive written papers), and Personality Test (Interview).

stages.source_label: HPPSC HPAS Combined Competitive Examination Notification & Scheme

papers.qualifying_threshold: 100 objective questions (2 marks each); marks count toward merit list to determine shortlist for Main Examination in ratio of 1:20 of vacancies
Minimum 33% (66 out of 200 marks) required to qualify; marks are not counted for merit shortlisting

stages.source_label: HPPSC HPAS Main Written Examination Syllabus & Regulations

papers.qualifying_threshold: Qualifying only; minimum 40% (40 out of 100 marks) required; marks not included in final merit ranking
Qualifying only; minimum 40% (40 out of 100 marks) required; marks not included in final merit ranking

papers.paper_name: Paper VII: Optional Subject — Paper I
papers.qualifying_threshold: Candidate selects one optional subject from the prescribed list of disciplines

papers.paper_name: Paper VII: Optional Subject — Paper II
papers.qualifying_threshold: Second paper of chosen optional discipline; total written merit prepared out of 900 marks
Candidates shortlisted in ratio of approximately 1:3 of vacancies based on written marks; final merit prepared out of 1,050 marks (900 Written + 150 Interview)

financial_package.note: Salaries for Himachal Pradesh Administrative Service officers are governed by the Himachal Pradesh Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules, 2022 notified by the Finance Department, Government of Himachal Pradesh. Entry-level HPAS Junior Scale / Sub-Divisional Magistrate posts are assigned Pay Matrix Level 18 with entry basic pay of ₹56,100.
financial_package.pay_source_label: HPPSC Advt. No. 59/8-2026 & HP Civil Services (Revised Pay) Rules 2022
financial_package.estimate_note: Gross salary computed from HP Pay Matrix Level 18 entry basic ₹56,100 + 58% DA (₹32,538) + HP HRA (8%–16% or government accommodation) + hill compensatory allowance / winter allowance (where applicable in notified tribal/hill districts) + conveyance, mobile, and medical allowances. In-hand estimate reflects 10% NPS deduction (Basic + DA), GIS, and professional tax.
official_perks: Designated government accommodation / residential bungalow at sub-division or district headquarters
Official staff car / vehicle with driver and fuel allotment for administrative and protocol duties
Medical reimbursement for self and dependents under HP State Services Medical Attendance Rules
Hill Compensatory Allowance (HCA) and winter heating allowance in designated hill postings
Official mobile handset, broadband connectivity, and telephone reimbursement
Leave Travel Concession (LTC) and travel allowances for field inspections
